sentences.text: Shri Rajesh Yadav - Advocate for the appellant.
Advocate General for the respon Shri Shiv Narayan - Advocate for the respondent/objector.
I.A.No. 15262/2024, application for urgent hearing stands disposed of.

Heard on I.A.No.15261/2024 which is sixth application under Section 389(1) of the Cr.P.C. filed on behalf of the appellant - Arjun @ Balram for grant of bail and suspension of remaining jail sentence.

2. Appellant stands convicted vide judgment dated 10.01.2017 passed by the learned Special Judge SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act 1989, District Dhar (MP) in Special Case No. 94/2014 and sentenced as under :
Section/Sentence Imprisonment Fine (Rs.) In lieu of fine 376(1) of IPC RI for life 15,000/- 06 months RI 5(L)(ii)/6 along with 3(ii-v) RI for life 1,00,000/- 1 year RI of SC/ST Act 450 of IPC RI for 3 years 1,000/- 01 months RI 506(II) of IPC RI for 1 year 500/- 01 month RI 3.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the appellant is pressing this application mainly on the ground of custody since the appellant has put in more than 10 years of jail incarceration.

This appeal is of the year 2017 and there is no likelihood of its early hearing, therefore, in light of judgment of the Apex Court in case of Sudan Singh V/s. State of U.P. [SLP (Crl.) No.4633/2021, decided on 05.10.2021 , the jail sentence of appellant is liable to be suspended.

2 CRA-559-2017 4. Per contra, learned counsel for the respondent/State as well for the objector oppose the application for suspension of sentence and prays for its rejection.

5. Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, submissions made by learned counsel for both the parties and taking note of the fact that appellant has completed more than 10 years of jail incarceration and that final conclusion of this appeal will take considerable time, we deem it Arjun @ Balram vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 10 March, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/189352586/
1 appropriate to suspend the remaining jail sentence of the appellant.
6.

sentences.text: Accordingly, I.A.No.15261/2024 is allowed and the execution of remaining jail sentence of the appellant is hereby suspended till the final disposal of this appeal.

It is directed that the appellant - Arjun @ Balram be released on bail subject to depositing the fine amount, if not already deposited and upon furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.10,000/- (Rupees Ten Thousand Only) with one solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, with a further direction to appear before the Registry of this Court on 29.04.2025 and on such other dates, as may be fixed by the Registry of this Court in this regard during the pendency of this appeal.
List for final hearing in due course.
